stem: A motor cyclist rides around the well with a round vertical wall and does not fall down while riding because: (a) the force of gravity disappears (b) he loses weight somehow (c) he is kept in this path due to the force exerted by surrounding air (d) the frictional force of the wall balances his weight
book_key: d the frictional force of the wall balances his weight

stem: A stone tied to the end of a string of 1 m long is whirled in a horizontal circle with a constant speed.
